products.title: Lava — Sculpt Layers for Blender
products.excerpt: Free Blender add-on — non-destructive sculpt layers. Record strokes to named layers, blend, lock & merge, from the N sidebar.
products.body:
**Lava — sculpt layers for Blender.** A free add-on that brings **non-destructive layers to Blender's sculpt mode**. Record your strokes onto named layers — *Base Pass*, *Big Forms*, *Wrinkles* — then blend, hide, lock, reorder or merge them without disturbing the work underneath.

**What it does**
- **Record strokes to a layer** — hit *Record Strokes* and everything you sculpt lands on the active layer.
- **Per-layer opacity, visibility & lock** — dial a layer's strength, toggle its eye, lock it to protect it.
- **Merge Down · Clear Layer · reorder** — the layer housekeeping you'd expect, right in the sculpt.
- **Lives in the N sidebar** — one keypress from the brush and beside the model, so checking a layer never costs you your place in the sculpt.

**Install**
1. Download the `.zip`.
2. In Blender: **Edit ▸ Preferences ▸ Add-ons ▸ Install…**
3. Pick the `.zip` and enable **Lava** — the panel appears in Sculpt Mode's **N** sidebar under *Layers*.

No strings — just hit Download. If you like it, a tag on socials is always appreciated. Prefer the browser? Try [Pocket Sculpt](/sculpt) — touch-first digital clay.

_Free — add the `.zip` link as `"download"` on this product in `store.json` to enable the button. Until then it shows as coming soon._

products.title: Blender Themes
products.excerpt: Free dark UI themes I use for environment work — download & import.
products.body:
A set of **free Blender themes** tuned for long environment-art sessions — calm contrast, clear selection colours, easy on the eyes.

**Install**
1. Download the `.xml` theme file(s).
2. In Blender: **Edit ▸ Preferences ▸ Themes ▸ Install…**
3. Pick the `.xml` and it applies instantly. Switch any time from the Themes presets.

No strings — just hit **Download**. If you like them, a tag on socials is always appreciated.

**Make your own:** try the free [Blender Theme Maker](/blendertheme) — design a theme live in your browser and export the `.xml`.
